title: scanCacheTree
responsibility: Recursively inventories regular files beneath a cache path without following symlinks, returning byte totals and reasons for entries it cannot safely inspect.

inputs.name: scanCacheTree.path
inputs.description: Path passed to lstat and readdir for inventory; it may identify a file or directory and may be relative or absolute. Symlinks are reported without traversal, and discovered file paths are relative to this root.

outputs.name: scanCacheTree
outputs.description: Resolved WalkResult lists relative paths for regular files and reasons for entries the walk could not inspect safely. The root result omits bytes for missing, uninspectable, symlink, or non-regular entries, while directory-list failures return zero bytes.
